boundary_convention: First tested loss for all three properties; conservative initial prefix. Last safe prefix is separately recorded. No infinite/1s replacement of censored boundaries.

staleguard_recovery_aware.note: Scheduling uses ceil-to-first-available 50 Hz step. Equality with an unsafe first-loss sample is late. Inside (last safe, first unsafe) is unresolved; right-censored cases have no invented deadline.

staleguard_dual_horizon.note: Scheduling uses ceil-to-first-available 50 Hz step. Equality with an unsafe first-loss sample is late. Inside (last safe, first unsafe) is unresolved; right-censored cases have no invented deadline.

staleguard.note: Scheduling uses ceil-to-first-available 50 Hz step. Equality with an unsafe first-loss sample is late. Inside (last safe, first unsafe) is unresolved; right-censored cases have no invented deadline.

geofence_turn.note: Always Recover initiates braking/position hold at each dispatch: matched recorded recovery starts can support sampled recovery profiles. It is not Underpass sideways recovery.

inspection_descent.note: Historical Always Recover initiates at approval for D>0 and executes the command at D=0. Repeated delays therefore do not independently sweep recovery initiation times; no recovery deadline is inferred.

claim_1.scope: Distinct execution/recovery opportunities in Underpass; distinct safety/completion opportunities in archived Geofence and Inspection results.
claim_1.limitations: Sampled simulator evidence, not exact continuous-time deadlines. Underpass safety and safe completion coincide; 190 scenarios have at least one right-censored boundary.

claim_2.scope: All three saved feasibility profiles independently checked on 7600 physical outcomes each; every recorded forecast is ready at a physically safe sampled recovery start.
claim_2.limitations: 25 command/completion and 12 recovery false-feasible labels; censored boundary mismatches; one non-monotonic predicted command profile. Warmed offline runtimes are replayed on the simulator clock, not an asynchronous hardware demonstration. No validation beyond 1 s.

claim_3.scope: Existing paired 400-scenario results and scenario-bootstrap confidence intervals reproduce exactly; independent sweeps confirm recovery feasibility failures.
claim_3.limitations: Trade-off, not universal dominance: complete StaleGuard sacrifices 58 safe inspections versus command-only EarlyRecovery and has 65 more unsafe flights than Fixed EarlyRecovery. No additional Underpass decision benefit from the completion condition; 279 of 381 net prevented unsafe flights versus command-only EarlyRecovery occur beyond the predictor horizon.
